answer: Temporal Interaction Proof.** Each agent must accumulate a chain of verifiable cross-context collaborations — showing past joint action with distinct independent agents — before earning identity weight. A jade artifact trade receipt, a dune survey log, a timber sale confirmation can each serve as one anchor, but an attacker cannot recycle the same chain across multiple identities. Every new fake identity must independently accumulate its own verified history from scratch, costing real coordination effort and exposing the attacker to detection when chains overlap.
